## Open Dental Software Reviews

What users are saying about Open Dental Software.

![](https://media.trustradius.com/profile-photos/615c5b7cfde000002b2db04c/4S8P4J1KSH9J.jpeg)

[Kathryn Allison](https://www.trustradius.com/users/615c5b7cfde000002b2db04c) [View profile](https://www.linkedin.com/in/kathryn-allison)

Front Desk Receptionist in Customer Service at Aspen Hill Smiles Family Dentistry (11-50 employees)

#### Use Cases and Deployment Scope

Open Dental \[Software\] is a vital tool to our office and we use it to handle every aspect of our patient care. It's convenient in that it allows us to combine staff and patient schedules with patient records, billing and personal information. At the front desk, we can view patient account balances/payments, upcoming procedures, x-rays and provider notes, which allows us to quickly answer patient questions and provide excellent customer service. Open Dental's customer service is excellent and provides support that allows us to customize the software to our individual practice's needs.

#### Pros

- Provider scheduling
- Billing
- Customer support
- Internal reports

#### Cons

- Open Dental \[Software\] has issues when users try to open more than one window at a time.
- There is no way to copy/paste provider schedules, so you have to schedule each day individually.

#### Most Important Features

- Affordability
- Great customer service
- Ease of use

#### Return on Investment

- Streamlining billing, scheduling, and record keeping into one program makes it easier to onboard new staff as they only have to learn to use one software.
- Having reports available in Open Dental \[Software\] make it easy to track insurance claims, income, and provider performance.

#### Pros

- User Interface is simple to learn
- Integrates well with all imaging programs
- Support techs are amazing, and remember your name when you call
- It's cheaper than almost all alternatives, but the value is higher
- Lots of plug-ins are available
- Awesome user community of dentists that love to talk about how they've incorporated plug-ins and other features
- Lots of reports to choose from, or you can make your own

#### Cons

- There are a few AR reports that would be nice to have as a template, so you don't have to make it on your own

#### Return on Investment

- The cost of Open Dental is minimal, so ROI is huge.
